request.style: English, female solo voice, warm and gentle, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, soft strings, reflective and narrative mood, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Terah lived in Ur of the Chaldeans
Father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran
Haran died in the land of his birth
While his father Terah was still alive on earth

[Verse]
Abram and Nahor both took wives
Sarai was the name that Abram lives
Nahor's wife was named Milcah
Daughter of Haran, born in that place

[Chorus]
She is the daughter of Haran
Iscah, named in the ancient clan
Sister to Lot and Milcah
Living in Ur, waiting to go

[Verse]
Sarai was barren, she had no child
Terah packed the family for a wild ride
Took his son Abram, grandson Lot
And Sarai, the wife, to go forth

[Chorus]
She is the daughter of Haran
Iscah, named in the ancient clan
Sister to Lot and Milcah
Living in Ur, waiting to go

[Bridge]
They left Ur of the Chaldeans behind
Heading for Canaan, a land to find
But when they came to Haran
They settled there, as the story began

[Chorus]
She is the daughter of Haran
Iscah, named in the ancient clan
Sister to Lot and Milcah
Living in Ur, waiting to go

[Outro]
Remains in the text, brief and clear
Iscah, daughter of Haran, appears
